label: Decisive action under pressure
definition: A documented consequential decision made under immediate operational pressure.

label: Procedural execution
definition: Documented completion or systematic development of a technically constrained procedure.

label: Technical innovation
definition: Documented creation, development, or transfer of a technical method, product, or system.

label: Nonviolent collective leadership
definition: Documented leadership of organized collective action using explicitly nonviolent methods.

label: Persistence under adversity
definition: Documented continuation of a sustained objective despite imprisonment, violence, abuse, or comparable material adversity.

label: Reconciliation and cooperation
definition: Documented work toward negotiated reconciliation, peaceful transition, or cooperation across a major conflict boundary.

label: Institution building
definition: Documented creation or durable leadership of an organization, institution, or governance structure.
